name: Forever To You
source:
Forever To You is 2D Erotic Visual Novel with elements of a card game and other mini games. Pleasant musical accompaniment, high-quality visuals of characters, beautiful backgrounds, variability of dialogues and much more that you still have to discover for yourself!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《永远属于你》是一款带有卡牌游戏和其他迷你游戏元素的2D色情视觉小说。愉快的音乐伴奏、高品质的角色视觉效果、美丽的背景、多变的对话等等，还有更多你需要自己去发现！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609010/]Steam[/url]]
